concepts.title: Two-way prepositions (Wechselpräpositionen)
concepts.summary: Nine prepositions take accusative for motion and dative for location.
concepts.explanation: Ask 'Wohin?' (where to?) for motion, which takes the accusative. Ask 'Wo?' (where?) for location, which takes the dative.

examples.german: Ich lege das Buch auf den Tisch.
examples.english: I put the book on the table.

examples.german: Das Buch liegt auf dem Tisch.
examples.english: The book is lying on the table.
